suppress.notes: False positive on spring-security 7.1.0. CVE-2026-47838 (X.509 SubjectDnX509PrincipalExtractor username confusion) only affects the 5.7.x-6.5.x lines; the equivalent 7.x issue was tracked as CVE-2026-22747 and fixed in 7.0.5. Matched via the broad vendor-level pivotal_software/vmware spring_security CPEs, which lack version-line granularity. See https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47838/

False positive on spring-security 7.1.1. CVE-2026-47842 (AesBytesEncryptor using an all-zero IV in AES/CBC mode) affects 7.1.0, 7.0.0-7.0.6, 6.5.0-6.5.11, 6.4.0-6.4.18, 5.8.0-5.8.27 and 5.7.0-5.7.25; 7.1.1 is the OSS release that fixes it. Matched via the broad vendor-level pivotal_software/vmware spring_security CPEs, which lack version-line granularity. Remove this suppression once Spring Boot manages spring-security >= 7.1.2 (or the NVD CPE ranges are corrected). See https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47842/

No fixed release available yet, and not exploitable through this library. Both are OSS Index-reported denial-of-service (CPU/memory) issues in jackson-databind, fixed upstream on 2026-09-14/15 but not yet released for any 3.x line (3.1.6 and 3.2.2 are the newest releases at the time of writing): - CVE-2026-91776 (https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/pull/6203): unbounded growth of the type id cache in TypeDeserializer. Requires polymorphic deserialization (@JsonTypeInfo / a TypeIdResolver). - CVE-2026-91777 (https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/pull/6204): quadratic forward-reference resolution in Collection/Map deserializers. Requires @JsonIdentityInfo object references. This starter only deserializes a flat {username, password} login body (FormUtil) and uses neither polymorphic typing nor object identity references. Consumer applications get their Jackson version from their own Spring Boot BOM, not from this starter. Remove this suppression once Spring Boot manages (or this pom overrides to) a jackson-databind release that contains both fixes (3.1.7+ / 3.2.3+).
